projects.title: Fashion MNIST Classifier
projects.one_liner: A zero-server-cost, client-side Fashion MNIST classifier built with TensorFlow.js, leveraging browser-native WebGL acceleration for absolute privacy and instant response.
projects.problem: Developers struggle to create high-performance, zero-server-cost machine learning applications that prioritize user privacy, leading to slow development cycles and limited scalability.
projects.goal: To deliver an elegant, interactive, and gamified web interface for users to classify uploaded images of apparel in real-time, leveraging client-side deep learning model inference for absolute privacy and zero server costs.
projects.architecture_diagram_code:
graph TD
A["User Uploads Image"] --> B["FileReader API Loads Data"]
B --> C["Render Uploaded Image to Preview Container"]
C --> D["Debounced Inference Trigger"]
D --> E["Image Element to 3D Tensor via tf.browser.fromPixels"]
E --> F["Resize to 224x224 pixels & Normalization 0.0 - 1.0"]
F --> G["Expand Batch Dimension to shape 1, 224, 224, 3"]
G --> H["tf.GraphModel Inference"]
H --> I["Extract Highest Probability Class Index"]
I --> J["Map to Fashion Category Label"]
J --> K["Update UI: Render Illustrative Category Icon"]
K --> L["Memory Cleanup: Dispose Input Tensor"]

performance.text: Optimizes client-side model inference for instant response and zero server costs

scale.text: Maintains sub-second processing and zero server overhead using stateless microservices

utility.text: Guarantees data correctness and API type-safety by enforcing runtime Zod schema boundaries

projects.title: Sprout
projects.one_liner: A Next.js frontend and ASP.NET backend application that leverages remote sensing technology to provide actionable insights to agricultural stakeholders, addressing key challenges in the agricultural sector.
projects.problem: Agricultural stakeholders struggle to access accurate and timely data on crop health, soil conditions, and weather patterns, making it challenging to make informed decisions about resource allocation, crop management, and climate adaptation strategies.
projects.goal: To provide a scalable and maintainable system that leverages remote sensing technology to deliver actionable insights to agricultural stakeholders, enabling data-driven decision-making and improving crop yields, resource allocation, and climate resilience.

key_features.text: NDVI forecasting for crop health and productivity analysis
Crop mapping and yield prediction for resource allocation and climate adaptation strategies
Drought monitoring and flood mapping for early warning systems and disaster preparedness
